title: Discrete Mean Field Games on Finite Graphs as Initial Value Optimization
summary: In this paper, we propose an initial value fomulation of the discrete mean field games on finite graphs (Graph MFG), and design a neural network based approach to solve it. Graph MFG describes infinite, non-cooperative and interactive homogeneous agents move on node states through the edges to optimize their own goals. Nash Equilibrium of the Graph MFG is characterized by a coupled ordinary differential equations (ODE) system, including the discrete forward continuity equation and the discrete backward Hamilton-Jacobi equation.
